correctness.rationale: The Lagrange inversion formula gives exact multivariate factorial moments. The extension moment ratio is bounded via three algebraic monotonicities, with verified positive denominators, yielding the all-order product inequality by induction. The equality cases arise only for the two minimal marked-block sizes. An independent exhaustive check confirmed 328671 assertions across exact Catalan enumerations and parameter bounds, which supplement rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: The sharp universal one-step product factor quantitatively controls simultaneous occurrences of arbitrary finite multisets of block sizes and all mixed factorial orders; unlike known Gaussian limits it provides finite-size strictly negative mixed covariances and sub-Poisson variances, with sharp equality for pairs. Such bounds have a natural use in Catalan random structure dependence and factorial-moment estimates.
